name: 无锋剑
source: 搜神记 第一卷 第一章 神农使者 / C01_B07

visual_identity.shape: heavy blunt black iron ruler-shaped weapon, rectangular bar body, flat square end, wrapped handle
visual_identity.material: dark worn iron with wet-stone patina
visual_identity.meaning: edgeless blunt ancient weapon; it should feel heavy and mysterious, not sharp or ornate

reference_review: Usable blunt Wufeng prop reference. It reads as a black iron ruler/training-sword-like weapon with flat end and no visible edge.
